floor.description: the earliest a schedule may build it again

builder.description: builds one output from its instruction (its doc body) and its inputs (its `reads` links)

key.description: the hash of the instruction, the model and each input's content hash it was built from

built.description: an output: what one builder built under one key. Its id is derived from the two, so an unchanged key names the output already built

builder_build.title: Build now
builder_build.description: Build a builder now, whatever its schedule says: hash its instruction, the model and each input's content into a key, and open one session on it unless an output under that key exists already. Passing a model other than the configured one builds a sibling output, which is how two models are compared on one builder. Returns one line: the output and the session building it, or the output that is already current.

builder.description: id of the builder to build

provider.description: the provider to ask instead of the configured one

model.description: the model to build with instead of the configured one

builder_open.description: build a builder whose floor has passed, unless its key is built

builder_ring.description: a wake fired on a builder: check whether it is due

builder_answer.description: a build's session answered: the answer is the output's body
